en.name: Apple cider vinegar
en.summary: Apple cider vinegar has no fixed shelf life, and that is the honest answer rather than a dodge. Vinegar preserves itself at its own acidity, so a capped bottle in a cool dark cupboard keeps almost indefinitely and the printed date is about flavour, not safety. Cloudiness, sediment and a gelatinous 'mother' in an unfiltered bottle are normal.
en.pantry: The cupboard is the right place: cool, dark, tightly capped, away from the cooker and out of sunlight. There is no number to give here, because the rule is the answer — vinegar's own acidity keeps it, which is why regulators list vinegar among the foods that need no 'use by' or 'best before' date at all. Never decant it into a bare metal container; the acid attacks the metal and the vinegar picks up the taste. Glass or food-grade plastic, capped tight, is all it asks for.
en.fridge: Apple cider vinegar does not need refrigeration and nothing is gained by it. A cold bottle will look cloudier, since chilling encourages sediment to drop out, which people sometimes misread as spoilage. If you prefer it cold for drinks or dressings, that is a matter of taste, not safety. Wherever you keep it, keep it capped — an open bottle loses aroma and slowly weakens.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for vinegar and no reason to freeze it. It is a shelf-stable acid that keeps itself, so freezer space is better used on something perishable. Freezing would also throw the sediment about and do nothing for the flavour.
spoilage: A genuinely off, solvent-like or rotten smell — rare, and different from vinegar's normal sharpness
Fuzzy coloured mould on the surface, as opposed to a smooth gelatinous mother
Anything floating in the bottle other than the pale sediment and mother you would expect
A bottle that has been stored in a metal container and now tastes metallic
tips: Keep it capped tight and out of sunlight; light and air cost more flavour than time does.
Strain out the mother if it bothers you, or leave it — it is harmless.
Do not store vinegar in bare metal; use glass or food-grade plastic.
Use distilled white vinegar for cleaning and keep the cider vinegar for food.

faq.q: Does apple cider vinegar go bad?
faq.a: Not in any practical sense. Its own acidity preserves it, so a capped bottle in a cool dark cupboard keeps almost indefinitely. The date on the label is about flavour.

faq.q: Does apple cider vinegar need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: No. A cool dark cupboard is ideal. Chilling only makes it look cloudier as sediment drops out.

faq.q: What is the cloudy blob in my vinegar?
faq.a: That is the mother — a harmless cellulose mat formed by the vinegar bacteria. Strain it out or ignore it.

faq.q: Can you freeze apple cider vinegar?
faq.a: There is no timeline and no reason to. It is shelf-stable on its own; keep the freezer for things that actually need it.

zh.name: 蘋果醋
zh.summary: 蘋果醋沒有固定的保存期限，而這是誠實的答案，不是推託。醋靠自己的酸度保存自己，所以蓋緊放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃裡幾乎可以無限期保存，瓶上的日期講的是風味而不是安全。未過濾的瓶子裡出現混濁、沉澱，甚至一團膠狀的「醋母」，都是正常的。
zh.pantry: 櫥櫃就是它的位置：陰涼、避光、蓋緊，遠離爐火和陽光。這裡沒有數字可以給，因為規則本身就是答案——醋靠自己的酸度保存，所以主管機關甚至把醋列為完全不需要標示有效日期的食品之一。絕對不要把醋倒進裸露的金屬容器；酸會侵蝕金屬，醋也會沾上金屬味。玻璃或食品級塑膠、蓋緊，就是它全部的需求。
zh.fridge: 蘋果醋不需要冷藏，冰了也沒有任何好處。冰過的瓶子看起來會更混濁，因為低溫會讓沉澱析出，有些人會誤以為是壞掉。如果你喜歡拿冰的來調飲料或沙拉醬，那是口味問題，不是安全問題。無論放哪裡，重點都是蓋緊——開著放會流失香氣，酸味也會慢慢變弱。
zh.freezer: 醋沒有冷凍期限，也沒有冷凍的理由。它本來就是能自我保存的常溫酸性液體，冷凍庫的空間留給真正需要的食材比較好。冷凍還會把沉澱攪得到處都是，對風味毫無幫助。
spoilage: 真的出現異味，像溶劑味或腐敗味——很少見，而且和醋本身的嗆酸不一樣
表面長出毛狀、有顏色的霉，而不是平滑膠狀的醋母
瓶中出現預期之外的漂浮物，而不只是淡色沉澱和醋母
曾經放在裸露金屬容器裡，現在喝起來有金屬味
tips: 蓋緊、避光；光和空氣造成的風味損失遠大於時間。
介意醋母的話濾掉即可，不介意就留著，它無害。
不要用裸露的金屬容器裝醋，請用玻璃或食品級塑膠。
清潔用白醋、食用用蘋果醋，分開使用。

faq.a: 實務上不會。它靠自己的酸度保存，蓋緊放陰涼避光的櫥櫃幾乎可以無限期保存。瓶上的日期講的是風味。
不用。陰涼避光的櫥櫃最理想。冷藏只會讓沉澱析出、看起來更混濁。

faq.q: 醋裡那團混濁的東西是什麼？
faq.a: 那是醋母，醋酸菌形成的纖維素膜，無害。想濾掉就濾掉，不想理它也沒關係。
沒有對應期限，也沒有必要。它本來就能常溫保存，冷凍庫留給真正需要的東西。
